subject: Math
subskill: Find the Percent from Two Values
prompt: While the weight of an object varies by location, shipping costs also vary by shipping method. A package costs $$150.00$ to ship domestically and $$187.50$ to ship internationally. The cost to ship the package via express shipping is $225%$ of the domestic shipping cost. If the international shipping cost is $x%$ of the express shipping cost, which of the following is closest to the value of $x$?
explanation: Choice C is correct. To find what percent the international shipping cost is of the express shipping cost, first calculate the express shipping cost. The express shipping cost is $225\%$ of the domestic cost, which means $2.25 \times 150.00 = 337.50$ dollars. Now calculate what percent $187.50$ dollars (international cost) is of $337.50$ dollars (express cost) using the formula $\frac{\text{part}}{\text{whole}} \times 100$. This gives $\frac{187.50}{337.50} \times 100 = 0.5556 \times 100 = 55.56\%$. Therefore, the international shipping cost is approximately $55.56\%$ of the express shipping cost.
